blocks.s: For fruitful contemplation Bernard requires seven things: humility, without which no spiritual building stands; compassion for one's neighbor, which dilates the heart; affliction willingly borne, which purifies the soul from self-love; compunction, which turns the heart from sin toward God; earnest prayer, which unites the soul to God; leisure of mind from external occupation; and a certain interior simplicity and freedom from turbulent imaginings.
